name: trend_ens_alts
description: Same trend ensemble on a point-in-time liquid universe: pit_top20 membership (survivorship-aware, incl. delisted coins), new entries only in the 10 most liquid coins (trailing-30d quote volume), open positions kept while the coin stays top-20. 6h bars.
mechanism: Time-series momentum: slow information diffusion plus attention/leverage-driven retail flow make crypto trends persist; averaging 9 speeds diversifies parameter risk; the channel-midpoint trailing exit keeps the right tail open. Counterparties: mean-reversion/range traders, late entrants, forced sellers. Funding gate: high perp funding = crowded leveraged longs that precede crashes (BIS WP 1087), so new longs are cut when the 7d mean funding is in the top decile of its trailing year or > 30% annualised.
universe: pit_top20 with top-10 entry filter (206 symbols ever member in 2020-01..2025-06)

btceth_6h.window: 2022-01-01..2025-06-30 (each fixed config, NO selection; not a tradable OOS number)

majors_6h.window: 2022-01-01..2025-06-30 (each fixed config, NO selection; not a tradable OOS number)

pit10_6h.window: 2022-01-01..2025-06-30 (each fixed config, NO selection; not a tradable OOS number)

frozen_rule: best median train Sharpe across the 7 walk-forward folds
trades_note: trades_per_day = position round trips opened per day (OOS); fills_per_day = all position changes incl. resizes
caveats: Verdict 'fails' despite the higher walk-forward Sharpe (0.60): the FROZEN (long-only) weights do NOT beat random-timing permutations with the same exposure (percentile 79, p=0.22; null median 0.64 because the 2021 bull pays any long exposure), DSR is 0.11 (54 trials) / 0.03 (324), and the median fixed config over 2022-2025H1 has Sharpe only 0.34. There is no evidence of a timing edge beyond exposure to the liquid-coin drift.
Survivorship-aware universe: delisted coins (LUNA, FTT, ...) are included and closed at the last price with a 2% haircut when their data stops.

Walk-forward OOS (2022-01..2025-06, 7 rolling folds, 730d train / 182d test, 54-config grid picked by train Sharpe): Sharpe 0.60, CAGR 6.5%, maxDD -19.5%, realised vol 11.6%. Phase-1 pass bar (OOS Sharpe >= 0.8) is NOT met.

Grid selection is noise-dominated. Here it happened to help: walk-forward 0.60 against a median FIXED config of only 0.34 over 2022-2025H1 (see grid_summary.grid_2022_window). On BTC+ETH and majors it hurt (the train winner landed at the 6th-50th percentile in each following test half-year on BTC+ETH).
Deflated Sharpe 0.115 with n_trials=54; with all 324 explored trials (6 universe x timeframe walk-forwards of 54) 0.034.
Random-timing null (same holding lengths/values, runs permuted per symbol) on FROZEN weights 2021-01..2025-06: percentile 79, p=0.218.

Realised vol is ~10-12%, not 20%: vol_target sizes the FULL-CONVICTION book (|signal|=1 on every active coin) to 20% ex-ante; partial ensemble signals keep exposure lower (mean gross ~0.2x). Returns scale ~linearly with vol_target (see vol_target_scaling_dev); drawdowns scale with it too.

Rebalance band is RELATIVE (trade when |target-held| > band x max(|target|,|held|)), not the spec's absolute 5-20% of equity: at 20% book vol a single coin's weight is ~1-8% of equity, so an absolute band would block nearly every entry.

Donchian entries/exits are evaluated only at 6h closes and filled at the next open (routine cadence). Resting server-side stop-market entries / conditional exits at the channel levels were not modelled.
2025H1 is negative in every universe/timeframe tried (chop + V-reversal regime); 2024 carries most of the OOS return.

Funding gate: walk-forward on gate-off configs only -> OOS Sharpe 0.52; gate-on configs only -> 0.61. Fixed-config effect (FROZEN with gate 1/0.5/0, 2022-2025H1 window): Sharpe 0.57/0.57/0.65, maxDD -18.0%/-17.9%/-17.6%. The gate mostly trims exposure; it does not change the verdict.
Signal warm-up: lookbacks without N days of history count as 0, so the 2020 part of the first training window (and newly listed coins) run on a damped signal.
Costs: Bybit taker 0.055%/side + tiered slippage (1/3/8 bp) + Binance funding history as a proxy for Bybit funding.
52 of the 206 pit symbols have no Bybit instrument under the same name (renamed e.g. 1000SHIB->SHIB1000, delisted, or never listed); in the $200 rounded run those orders are rejected.

Gate-off-only walk-forward (18 configs, a spec-requested variant): OOS Sharpe 0.52, CAGR 5.9%, maxDD -20.6% (2022 +5.0%, 2023 +1.1%, 2024 +16.6%, 2025H1 -1.4%); DSR (54 trials, headline skew/kurt) 0.088. The gap to the headline sits almost entirely in fold 0 (2022H1), i.e. in which config the 2020-21 training window happened to pick. Treat it as selection luck, not as evidence that the gate hurts.
$200 account with Bybit qty rounding at vol_target 0.20: dropped-order share 87%, Sharpe 0.96 vs 1.04 fractional (dev period). Many resizes are below the $5 minimum notional at this size.
lockbox: not touched (all panels end 2025-06-30, pre_lockbox applied)
